name: DOA

tenures.source: Its championship history page: DOA, Tag Team champions twice.

caption: A Tag Team champion team that beat the Ring Generals on eXposed in December 2007 and took the titles back from Shawn Hunt and Brian Cady at Violence on 30 March 2008.

name: The Ring Generals

tenures.source: Its championship history page: the Ring Generals in four Tag Team entries.

caption: Won the Tag Team titles in a match of the first GoldRush and lost them to Stoner and Dark Wolf at Violence on 31 August 2007, and beat Stoner and Johnny Mara for them in a match the page cannot date.

name: Team Vendetta

tenures.source: Its championship history page: Team Vendetta, first Tag Team champions.

caption: The first Tag Team champions, crowned at GoldRush on 16 June 2007 and beaten the same night by the Ring Generals.
